question: Who was appointed as the Union Minister of Law and Justice in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiren Rijiju**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiren Rijiju **was appointed as the **Union Minister of Law and Justice **in** July 2021.**
 
• He is an Indian politician hailing from Arunachal Pradesh, has held several key positions in the Government of India.
 
• Currently, since **2023 and 2024, **he serves as th**e Cabinet Minister of Earth Sciences and Food Processing Industries.**
 
• He has represented the Arunachal West constituency in the Lok Sabha, India's lower house of Parliament, since 2014, and previously from 2004 to 2009.
 
• From 2014 to 2019, he served as the **Minister of State for Home Affairs**. Subsequently, from 2019 to 2021, he held the portfolio of Minister of State for Minority Affairs alongside Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Sports and Youth Affairs.
 
• From 2021 to 2023, he served as the Law Minister in the Government of India.
 
• Throughout his tenure, Rijiju has played a significant role in shaping policies related to home affairs, minority affairs, sports, youth affairs, and law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Narendra Singh Tomar,** a former Minister of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, has held various ministerial positions in the Government of India, including Minister of Rural Development, Minister of Panchayati Raj, Minister of Mines, and Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
 
• **Mahendra Nath Pandey, **an Indian politician, currently serves as Minister of Heavy Industries. Previously, he served as Minister for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship and has been a Member of Lok Sabha for Chandauli since 2014.
 
• **Rajnath Singh,** an Indian politician and lecturer, has been serving as the 29th Defence Minister of India since 2019. He also holds the position of Deputy Leader of the House in Lok Sabha since 2014.
